title: Cheddar-Basil-Butter Tomato Toasts
description:
F&W: Peak-season tomatoes meet a fluffy cheddar-basil butter for an easy toast that balances juicy, sweet, tangy, and savory flavors in every bite. There are few summer pleasures as satisfying as a perfectly ripe tomato layered onto toasted bread. This recipe builds on that timeless pairing with a whipped cheddar-basil butter that adds tomatoes’ favorite pairings and loads them all onto toast. The result is simple enough for a quick lunch but impressive enough to serve as an appetizer when tomatoes are at their seasonal best.
The secret is treating the tomatoes with a little extra care. A brief sprinkle of salt draws moisture to the surface, concentrating the fruit’s natural sweetness while helping prevent excess liquid from soaking into the toast. The tomatoes become more flavorful, making them an even better match for the creamy spread underneath.
ingredients: 2 medium (8-ounce-each) heirloom tomatoes, trimmed and cored
4 ounces extra-mature sharp white cheddar cheese, shredded (such as Cabot) (about 1 cup)
1/2 teaspoon coarsely ground black pepper, plus more for garnish
2 tablespoons roughly chopped fresh basil, plus more for garnish
directions: Slice tomatoes 1/4-inch thick and place on a paper towel–lined plate. Sprinkle evenly with 1/2 teaspoon salt; let stand until juices start to bead up on surface of tomatoes, 3 to 5 minutes.

Meanwhile, combine cheese, butter, garlic, pepper, and remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt in a stand mixer bowl fitted with a paddle attachment; beat on medium until smooth and creamy, about 1 minute. Fold in basil until evenly distributed. Set aside.

Spread 2 tablespoons butter mixture over 1 side of each toasted bread slice; reserve remaining 1/2 cup butter for another use. Top evenly with seasoned tomatoes. Sprinkle with additional basil and pepper, if desired. Serve immediately.
